equation_summary: y_i = softmax(scale * q_i k_j^T over causal-visible keys) v_j with an explicit query->KV head map; in the equal-head case the map is identity (HQ == H, G = HQ // H = 1). The fla naive reference reshapes q to [B,T,H,G,D] and shares k across the group dim; the flash pin documents the same MQA/GQA head-broadcast ABI. Optional per-head cumulative gate bias and sink bias exist in the fla reference but are not part of plain MHA.
state_shape: no persistent mixer state; external KV cache [B,T,H,D] managed by the model module
